design.purpose: Research individual differences without changing live strategy
design.training: prior 5 calendar years, outcomes of every exit variant completed before annual decision; no held-out claims because historical years already studied

selection.paired_improvement_threshold: positive paired mean gain and mean-3*max(stock-cluster SE, signal-quarter-cluster SE)>0; for single-stock groups use signal-year clusters, require 3 years; otherwise global/baseline fallback
selection.ranking: mean paired net return gain, no after-the-fact parameter tuning

state_groups.sector: current classification descriptive only, not PIT selector

portfolio.execution: next market session open only, no future-aware replacements; cash plus marked open positions
portfolio.boundary: open positions stay marked, not counted as closed trades

gates: positive event mean gain and win or PF gain in 2016-2020 and 2021-2023
CAGR and MDD cannot both deteriorate; tradeoffs reported, not auto adopted
final chronological audit 2024+ and 1% cost stress; no fresh unseen-data claim
limitations: present archive survivor bias; original exchange membership unavailable
US archive is Yahoo quoted OHLC, split conventions and cash dividends not fully reconstructed
TW adjusted-price wealth approximation, no explicit dividend-tax cash ledger
TW source suspicious discontinuities must be audited; cannot delete future losing events
no publication-time financial histories in selectors; no new paid data or model API

refinement_before_outcomes.reason: account for shared market episodes as well as stock clustering; no outcome comparison had been run

design.execution_integrity_refinement: No next-bar existence/liquidity eligibility when ranking candidates; zero-volume opens do not fill, no replacement. Hold count uses valid stock trading bars, suspension retains marked holdings. All baseline and variants rerun if implementation changes; prior drafts retained.
